summary: Verified telecaller dashboard (/agent/dashboard) and Lead Detail edit status options for web app. All 8 test cases from the review request passed. Period filters (Today, This Week, This Month, All Time, Custom) render correctly; Status Breakdown displays only 4 statuses (Not Interested, Follow Up, Lead, File) with no 'New' or 'Presentation'; Call Outcomes section shows all 6 outcomes; Today's Activity shows Calls Made, Talk Time, Avg Call, Idle Time; top stats show My Data / Unused / Calls; Lead Detail edit-status buttons show only the 4 allowed options. Mobile app (React Native) code was reviewed in files_of_reference only; not runtime-tested per instructions.

issues: Existing legacy leads still carry status='new' and display a 'New' badge on the Data list and Lead Detail header. Since 'new' is no longer selectable, existing leads keep this legacy value. Consider a one-time data migration to map legacy 'new'/'presentation' statuses to an allowed value (e.g. follow_up) so displayed badges match the reduced status set.
